name: Pass It Around
idea: Move the ball with quick passes until a teammate gets open.
why: The ball flies faster than any defender can run. Quick passes make the defense scramble, and soon someone gets left open.
tryit: Play hot potato with a friend: pass the moment you catch it. Can you make 10 passes in a row without a drop?

frames.say: Meet the team! Blue {1} has the ball. Each red defender guards one blue player.
{1} passes to {2}. Zoom! The ball moves faster than anyone can run.
{2} passes it back to {1}. The defenders have to keep sliding to keep up.
{1} swings it to {3}. {X3} was helping in the middle and is still running back!
{3} has lots of space, so {3} shoots! Good passing finds the open player.
